title: Batch B live config rerun can fail when nested blocked-prereq retry removes the same prereq twice
symptom: The Batch B rerun rooted at campaign a10d79ab failed on contoso_config.dll job 6427b1c6 with explore_error = "'CFG_ApproveLicensedCall'" while replaying the config prerequisite chain. The failure occurred after same-run prerequisite successes had already been recorded for CFG_BindCustomer, CFG_OpenLicensedWindow, and CFG_GetLicenseNonce, which narrowed the issue to retry bookkeeping rather than package comparability.
smallest_reproducer: wave-2-batch-b campaign a10d79ab config child 6427b1c6 on CFG_RunCustomerSync / CFG_ApproveLicensedCall prerequisite replay with live same-run promotion active
trust_impact: This specific rerun is not decision-bearing because the config child terminated with a deterministic pipeline error before the campaign could emit trustworthy wave artifacts.
allowed_next_actions: patch blocked-prereq retry bookkeeping so nested resumption cannot double-delete the same prereq
add a local proof for nested blocked-prereq consumption under hint-generation advancement
restart the local API and bridge so s02_probe picks up the repaired code
rerun only wave-2-batch-b after local validation is green
disallowed_next_actions: analyze overlap deltas from campaign a10d79ab as if it were trustworthy
treat the config error as DLL behavior
launch another live Batch B before the retry bookkeeping fix is validated locally
exit_criteria: local nested blocked-prereq retry proof passes
